verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਲਿਵ ਦੇਖੈ ਅਉ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਦਰਸ ਏਕ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas liv dhekhai aau dhikhaavai soiee sarab dharas ek dharas kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: An obedient disciple of the Guru who has focused his vision in the glimpse of the True Guru, he observes the impermeable Lord everywhere and every place. He makes others see Him too. He regards and understands that all philosophies are present in His sight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਸਬਦ ਏਕ ਸਬਦ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv kahat sunat soiee sarab sabadh ek sabadh kai maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: When a Guru-oriented person acquires the teachings of the True Guru, his mind gets absorbed in the practicing of Lord's Naam Simran. He then speaks and hears the words of the True Guru deep in his soul. He regards all singing modes engrossed in the melody of the divine words.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਤਗਿ ਸਰਬਗਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaaran karan karatag sarabag soiee karam karatoot karataar pahichaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: In this state of immersion in the elixir of Naam, a Guru oriented slave recognises the cause of all causes, the knower of all deeds and capable of knowing all; who is the doer of all the deeds-the Doer and Creator,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ॥ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੈ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੀਐ ॥੩੦੧॥
verses.translit_en: satigur giaan dhiaan ek hee anek mek|| braham bibek Tek ekai ur aaneeaai ||301||

en.bdb: And thus a Guru-conscious person becomes aware of One God through the knowledge blessed by the True Guru and perpetual contemplation of Him, Such a person leans on none else for support except One All-pervading Lord, (301)
